en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large half-timbered guesthouse or inn on a country road in a forested area. An early motorcar is parked in front and a man in period clothing stands in the road. The wooden building has signs on the facade, including one reading "Bergeshöhe." A large advertisement fence on the right promotes a 'Miet-Automobil' (rental car). The title text at the top identifies the location as Oberbärenburg in the Saxon Ore Mountains (sächs. Erzgebirge).
